declarations.name: BaseElement
declarations.description:
A base custom element used to exercise inheritance-aware manifest
generation. It declares a reactive property (`aBase`) and a public
method (`baseMethod`) which subclasses may inherit.

members.name: aBase
members.description: A reactive property declared on the base class only.

members.name: baseMethod
members.description: A method declared on the base class only.

declarations.name: DerivedElement
declarations.description:
A custom element that extends `BaseElement` in the same package. It
declares its own reactive property (`derivedStr`), shadows `aBase` from
the base class with a different type, and overrides `baseMethod`.

In the `inheritProperties` manifest mode, the non-overridden members
from `BaseElement` (e.g. the original `aBase` field if it were not
shadowed) would be added to this element's manifest entry with an
`inheritedFrom` reference to `BaseElement`. This test verifies that
the shadowed members from the base class are NOT inherited and that
any new base-class members added in the future will be picked up
automatically.

members.name: derivedStr
members.description: A property declared only on the derived element.

members.name: aBase
members.description:
A property that shadows `aBase` from `BaseElement`. The derived
declaration should win in the manifest.

members.name: baseMethod
members.description: A method declared on the base class only.

declarations.name: IndependentElement
declarations.description:
A custom element with no inheritance relationship to the other test
elements. Used to verify that inheritance walking does not affect
elements without an ancestor in the same package.
